lines.text: Near Jerusalem at Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sends two disciples to bring a donkey and her colt.
This fulfills the prophet's words that Zion's King comes gentle and riding on a donkey.
The disciples bring the donkey and the colt, lay their cloaks on them, and Jesus sits on them.
A massive crowd spreads cloaks and branches on the road and shouts Hosanna to the Son of Aaron.
The whole city is stirred, and the crowds say Jesus is the prophet from Nazareth in Judea.
